class.name: HTMLInputEvent
class.brief_description: An input edit event such as [code]beforeinput[/code] or [code]input[/code].
class.description: [code]beforeinput[/code] is cancelable and runs before supported keyboard, paste, cut, and history edits. Cancelling it leaves the editor value unchanged.

members.member: Text inserted by this edit, or an empty string when the edit does not insert text.
The edit operation, such as [code]insertText[/code], [code]deleteContentBackward[/code], or [code]historyUndo[/code].
Whether the edit belongs to an active IME composition.
